inputs.label: PS2 BIOS dump and PS2 games
inputs.help: A BIOS dump from your own PS2 console and your own PS2 games (.iso, .chd, .cso, .bin/.cue or .gz).

steps.text: If you have another ARMSX2 build installed, uninstall it first. Otherwise the install fails with a signature mismatch.
Open ARMSX2 from Library > Unknown Sources and grant storage access. Choose your BIOS and point the app at the Download folder. Games open on a curved 3D screen.

notes: The guide does not name the BIOS file type; .bin is assumed, which is why the BIOS shares one input with the games. A separate BIOS input would be clearer once its extension is confirmed.
